# Elite Bengal Cattery

> Ethically Bred Purebred Bengal Kittens with Exceptional Rosettes and Wild Elegance

Elite Bengal Cattery is an elite, TICA-registered hobby cattery in North Carolina specializing in championship bloodline Bengal kittens with wild rosettes, sweet temperament, and certified genetic health.

Located in Raleigh & Charlotte Metro Area, North Carolina, USA. Contact via WhatsApp at +1 720 310 0222 or email at elitebengalcattery28@gmail.com.
Free white-glove pet courier delivery across the United States. 10% instant discount when reserving via cryptocurrency.

## Available Bengal Kittens
- [Brown Rosetted Bengals](https://DOMAIN.com/shop/brown-rosetted/): Warm golden undercoats with striking two-tone jaguar-like doughnut rosettes.
- [Snow Bengal Kittens](https://DOMAIN.com/shop/snow-bengals/): Breathtaking ivory coats, glacier-blue eyes, and delicate cocoa leopard rosettes.
- [Silver & Charcoal Bengals](https://DOMAIN.com/shop/silver-charcoal/): Gleaming pewter coats with pitch-black markings and exotic midnight masks.
- [Breeding & Show Rights](https://DOMAIN.com/shop/breeding-rights/): Exceptional structural conformation, strong chin, wild profile, and fertile champion pedigrees.
